text: {"lessons":["Selling at a gain felt rewarding, but those sales did not prove I had made the best decision; I should judge trades by my overall goals, not by whether each stock is above my purchase price.","After selling, I later bought the stocks again, often at different prices. I should make each buy or sell decision using current circumstances rather than treating my old sale price or average cost as a target.","I held through several monthly declines and the account later partly recovered, but that does not show what prices will do next. I should avoid reacting to short-term moves and follow a plan that fits my needs and risk tolerance."]}
